title: UW–Madison designates 2026 as the ‘Year of AI Readiness and Competency’
summary_en: The effort, which supports a number of campus priorities, will focus on a people-centered approach to guide thoughtful use of artificial intelligence on campus.

title: $85.2 million gift from John and Tashia Morgridge will support Science Hall transformation
summary_en: The historic building will undergo renovation starting in 2027 to restore its iconic exterior, create new gathering space and modernize its interior to support learning and research.
